# Sunil Kumar Saxena — Graphic Design Portfolio

> Freelance graphic designer based in Bhopal, India. Portfolio featuring branding, brochures, publications, social media campaigns, and print design. The website states 20+ years of professional experience.

Canonical website: https://sunilkumarsaksena-hub.github.io/

## About
Sunil Kumar Saxena is a graphic designer whose portfolio showcases visual communication and design work across branding, editorial and publication design, brochures, advertising, social media creatives, and print.

## Selected portfolio projects
- Dastan-e-Mohabbat — original two-volume book series, written and designed by Sunil Saxena.
- Mahakumbh 2025 — editorial booklet.
- CORTIJO Bhopal — coffee table book.
- SAGE University — coffee table books, brochures, prospectus, advertising, and convocation creatives.
- SAGEX — premium education brochure.
- SAGE TIMES — Swarnim 2026 highlights newsletter.
- Chai Pe Charcha — branding and stationery mockups.

## Areas of work
- Graphic design and visual communication
- Brand identity and branding applications
- Brochures, prospectuses, and education marketing collateral
- Editorial design, books, and publications
- Social media campaigns and advertising creatives
- Print design and promotional materials
